interpretations: For each patient with a matching lab record and a nonblank, nonmissing sex, calculate the mean of their recorded `ALB` values and the mean of their computable `UN` ÷ `T-BIL` ratios across lab tests; then average each measure across patients of the same sex, retaining sexes whose average `ALB` exceeds the unweighted mean of the sex-level `ALB` averages, and report the sex, both sex-level averages, and the `ALB` difference without rounding.
queries:
WITH patient_means AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX,
           AVG(l.ALB) AS mean_alb,
           AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l."T-BIL", 0)) AS mean_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> ''
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_means AS (
    SELECT SEX,
           AVG(mean_alb) AS avg_alb,
           AVG(mean_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM patient_means
    GROUP BY SEX
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_sex_alb
    FROM sex_means
)
SELECT s.SEX,
       s.avg_alb,
       s.avg_un_tbil_ratio,
       s.avg_alb - o.avg_sex_alb AS alb_difference
FROM sex_means AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE s.avg_alb > o.avg_sex_alb
